that's a VERY correct ruling. planeswalkers cannot have negative counters on them. nothing can have negative counters on it (even though -1/-1 counters cancel out +1/+1, they are both positive numbers of counters, and you cannot remove so many +1/+1 counters that you get -1/-1 counters. +1/+1 counters and -1/-1 counters are not relevant to this ruling, I'm just using them to illustrate a point.).

most is correct, but this part is not, and the rule it cites does not support it:

 In other multiplayer variants, the active player may choose a defending player as a turn-based action at the start of the beginning of combat step [507.1], and that player (along with any other defending players dictated by the variant) will get priority after the active player in each step.

That said, rule 507.1 is probably pretty important to surface if we aren't 100% sure that the game is not a 2 player game. maybe we need to add something to our system prompt where if they don't specify the number of players, that we surface any rulings that would be relevant for both 2 players and more than 2 players. [802.2] should also be surfaced because it defines that in a multiplayer game, all the attacking player's opponents become the defending player.
